name: services Report draft
query:
SELECT 
    I.item_code AS "Item Code:Data:250",
    I.item_group AS "Service Type:Data:150",
    I.description AS "Description:Data:250",
    SUM(I.qty) AS "Total Qty:Float:120",
    AVG(I.net_rate) AS "Average Net Rate:Currency:120",
    SUM(I.net_amount) AS "Total Net Amount:Currency:150"

FROM 
    `tabSales Invoice` S

INNER JOIN 
    `tabSales Invoice Item` I 
    ON S.name = I.parent

WHERE 
    S.docstatus = 0
    AND S.so_type = 'Pharmacy'
    AND S.posting_date BETWEEN %(Start_date)s AND %(End_date)s

GROUP BY 
    I.item_code,
    I.item_group,
    I.description

ORDER BY 
    I.item_code;
